command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

stop.question: The specify stage's scope check cannot pass on this branch, and the only way to make it pass would break your decision. The check takes its base from the parent of 'gnomish: task started' (d3156b0^ = 6e8e7c7), but main was merged into the branch afterwards (ba035ca, which brings in 9ed4a58 'Allow iana egress in gnomish sandbox (#118)'). Because of that, the check counts three files from main as edits made by this stage: .gnomish/factory/project.yaml.example.container, .gnomish/factory/sandbox/Dockerfile and packages/client/scripts/zoneRules/tz-coordinator-key.asc. Its fix ('git checkout <base> -- <file>') would delete the pinned tz coordinator key, which your decision says is committed on main and must not be replaced. Task 3.1 (FR7) needs that key, and the sandbox cannot fetch it. The change artifacts under openspec/changes/add-zone-rules-from-iana/ and the change record are in place, so only this check is failing. How should this go forward?
options: Re-base the task start (or move the 'gnomish: task started' marker after the merge ba035ca) so the scope check measures from the merged main; I keep the three files and change nothing else
Revert the three files on this branch with 'git checkout 6e8e7c7 -- <file>' so the check passes, and accept that the implement stage has no pinned key until the branch is merged with main again
Waive the scope check for these three files (they come from main commit 9ed4a58) and run the judge on the change as it is
